facts.fact: Certa Foundation says the updated Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) manages cases from investigation to execution, with case tracking and a block on duplicate registrations.
Certa Foundation says lawyers trained on 23 January 2025 create IECMS accounts and file civil and criminal cases and submit documents digitally.

RWA.note: Says IECMS covers cases from investigation but states nothing on police station records.
No tax or fee payment stated.
